title: RACE INFORMATION — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: The 2026 event is split into two weeks: Week 1 at Doi Inthanon National Park Office on 27-29 November 2026 with PAGODA 50 DAY/NIGHT, INTHANON 20 and a warm-up run, and Week 2 at Chiang Mai PAO Park on 3-6 December 2026.
The listed early-bird fees are THB 4,300 for PAGODA 50 DAY/NIGHT, THB 2,600 for INTHANON 20, THB 8,500 for CHIANG DAO 160, THB 6,500 for ELEPHANT 100, and THB 1,500 for CHEDI 20.
The page states that the fees are early-bird prices and will increase automatically when registrations reach a predetermined level.
